description: Golden evaluation set for the Operations Council course. Tests correct category, priority, and response quality for each agent.

cases.name: password_reset_basic
cases.input:
Ticket ID: T-1001
Subject: Can't log in

I can't log in to my account this morning. I tried my usual password and it's not working. I haven't changed it. Help!

cases.name: billing_dispute_medium
cases.input:
Ticket ID: T-1002
Subject: Charge looks wrong

My March invoice has a $1,247 charge for AI Platform that doesn't match what I've used. I checked the usage page and it shows about $300 of activity.
cases.notes: Specific dollar amount + documented discrepancy = HIGH, not MEDIUM.

cases.name: outage_report_high
cases.input:
Ticket ID: T-1003
Subject: Is something down?

Our API calls to Cloud Storage have been timing out for the last 20 minutes. We're in us-east1. Status page doesn't show anything.
cases.notes: Active impact to production + no status page entry = HIGH.

cases.name: quota_issue_medium
cases.input:
Ticket ID: T-1004
Subject: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on Vertex

Started getting RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors on text-embedding requests around 9am Pacific. We're well under our previous usage. Did something change?
cases.notes: Sudden onset without usage change often means quota adjustment — HIGH.

cases.name: escalation_critical
cases.input:
Ticket ID: T-1005
Subject: Need a refund — this is urgent

We were billed $3,400 for a service we cancelled in February. I have the cancellation confirmation. I need a human to look at this immediately or I'm going to escalate to my legal team.
cases.notes: Legal threat → CRITICAL + ESCALATION_NEEDED. Human review flag mandatory.

cases.name: megaticket_multi_issue
cases.input:
Ticket ID: T-megaticket-001
Subject: Multi-issue: cancellation, refund, and a current outage

Three things. (1) We cancelled our contract on Feb 10 but were still charged $4,200 in March — we want a refund of the full amount. (2) Our remaining production workloads are seeing intermittent timeouts to Cloud Storage in us-central1 — about 1 in 20 requests fails. (3) When this is sorted, please send us instructions on exporting our remaining data so we can move off the platform. Time-sensitive — we have a board update in 48 hours.
cases.notes: All three sub-issues must appear in draft response. CRITICAL because of board deadline + billing amount.
